# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v1.1.0

Feature release for the local-first, app-like C300X Home Assistant custom
integration. It updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.1.0`.

## Added

- Adds HA-side Ring Call capture diagnostics that retain a raw mono WAV next to
  the MP4 capture for speech analysis.
- Adds local Wyoming Whisper transcription for the newest retained Ring Call raw
  WAV. This path does not use image analysis or cloud AI.
- Adds an optional strict phrase-match evaluation service that can unlock the
  configured C300X door only when `unlock_on_match` is explicitly enabled.

## Changed

- Reduces Ring Call capture audio distortion risk by removing dynamic
  normalization from the MP4 audio path. The MP4 keeps moderate gain and limiting;
  the raw WAV remains unfiltered for Whisper.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating so the new services are registered.
- Ring Call capture files are runtime artifacts under `/media/c300x/` or
  `/config/www/c300x/`; do not commit them to the repository.
- This release keeps the Home Assistant minimum version at `2026.5.0`.
